learning_outcomes.text: To determine heat transfer modes and mechanisms.
To calculate heat transfer in plate wall and cylindrical wall and shares surfaces.
Can able to solve heat transfer problems related to extended surface.
Can able to solve transient heat transfer problems.

syllabus_topics: Differential equation of heat conduction. Some special cases. Boundary conditions.
One-dimensional, steady-state conduction. The plane wall. Heat conduction with convection. Overall heat transfer coefficient. Thermal resistance and thermal contact. Isıl temes
Radial Systems: The Cylinder, The Sphere.
Heat transfer from extended surfaces. Fin performance.
Heat conduction at steady state two dimensional systems. Finite difference method.
Finite difference method for transient heat conduction.
